rows.subject: lem-alternating-hook-induction-cancels-disconnected-rim-removals

evidence.note: Reader added the missing rightmost-overlap argument and corrected the selected-row label from an incorrect indexing rule to k+1.

Checked every step of the LR filling/counting proof against all eight supplier interfaces and James 21.5 with its full proof, printed pp.81–82. Unique labels >1 must occur rightmost and in increasing rows; the first nonempty row contains only ones. A 2x2 forces equal ones in a column. In the inverse construction a lower overlapping cell is rightmost, so the kth selected row receives k+1 and strict columns and the lattice word follow. Column-convexity implies consecutive overlapping occupied rows are adjacent partition rows. With f overlaps, f=r-c and m=w-f, hence binom(m-1,c-x). Component columns are disjoint, so c>=m and all nonzero x are in [1,r]. Alternating row sums give the stated connected height sign, zero for disconnected shapes, with m=1 and r=1 explicit. Noncontainment gives zero by the LR definition. Finite sums and canonical ordered fillings require no AC. Accept the reader inverse-construction and range repairs.

rows.description: Reader repaired Proof 5.1 falsely locating arbitrary remaining basis vertices in a complementary summand; current raising induction and partial inverse prove the splitting.

evidence.note: Reviewed the complete eight-step proof, current semisimplicity supplier and all other exact cited interfaces, plus Kashiwara91 pp.478-479 complete Lemmas 2.6.1-2.6.3. rows.note: The old maximal-degree extraction falsely inferred radical annihilation of a whole finite-dimensional span. Highest-vector annihilation and ideal stability now prove the required assertion.

evidence.note: Exact pre-reader bytes

Finite graded PBW pieces are p-stable because positive radical degree raises the zeta eigenvalue and the degree-zero Levi module is killed. A parabolic Verma quotient factors through the finite cyclic Levi simple, since the radical kills its highest vector and its whole Levi span. Local nilpotence of each f_j is equivalent to Levi local finiteness: the sl2 identity forces each simple factor to have dominant integral Levi weight. PBW with the finite radical span proves p-local finiteness, including extensions. Chevalley duality preserves locally finite Levi direct sums. J=empty gives ordinary O; J=S gives finite-dimensional modules, and the corrected sl2 example has M_p(0)=L(0).

rows.description: Proof 1.1 restricts standardness-preserving incomparable swaps to consecutive labels, which is precisely what the later chain uses.

evidence.detail: Checked all ten steps and clauses over arbitrary R with unit q. Adjacent standard swaps reverse transposed lengths; column-block expansion and the count induction give a unit triangular minor. The signed quotient maps onto zH and kills higher ideals by opposite dominance; the square surjection pi F is invertible, proving spanning and splitting without semisimplicity. Gram coefficients include diagonal and zeros, and finite straightening uses C inverse rather than an asserted signed-belt induction. Confirmed refuter:12:1 at lambda=(3,2): w=(1,4,2,5,3) is increasing on mu blocks, its inverse is not; corrected Proof 1.3 to w inverse in D_mu. Confirmed refuter:12:2: F3 is partition-only; Proof 2.2 now defines composition y_alpha,N_alpha and derives its common sign eigenspace and longest coefficient. Sorting parts preserves N, so the conjugation scalar cancels. Universal Laurent identities and n=0,1/zero-ring/degenerate-form boundaries hold; no AC or quantum-factorial division.
